verdict.rationale: All MCP-related evidence describes Greptile exposing its own MCP server so other tools (Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, Codex) can pull Greptile's review data and fixes (docs-23, docs-24, probe-4) — this is Greptile acting as the MCP server, not as a client that consumes external MCP servers' tools. There is no evidence Greptile itself can be configured to plug in and use third-party MCP servers/tools.
